laura_sales: Need a tight handoff for a health-tech POC. Requirements from their NetOps: preserve client IP for audit logs, allow TLS inspection inline, warn about SNI rewrite impact on cert pinning/mTLS, and give explicit egress IPs/FQDNs for firewall allowlist. Also want a 2-week POC cost bullet.

ryan_netops: High level: peering preserves source IP end-to-end; PrivateLink is fast to stand up but commonly results in source-NAT to endpoint EIPs unless you front with a proxy/NLB. Dedicated/private tenancy required for proxy-protocol passthrough.

jun_infra: POC options we recommend (pick based on their constraints):
- Cross-account VPC Peering: native src-IP preservation, simplest for src-based ACLs and for auditors.
- PrivateLink + customer-side NLB + reverse proxy: fastest onboarding, preserves client identity via X-Forwarded-For header.
- Private deployment (VPC or on-prem): for teams that require mTLS termination on our side or proxy-protocol v2.

security_ops: Important: if their TLS inspector terminates or rewrites SNI, cert pinning and mTLS will break. Mitigations: terminate mTLS at their boundary and re-auth at app layer, or provision a Dedicated instance and sign the necessary DPA/addendum.

ryan_netops: Copy/paste allowlist for their perimeter (replace placeholders):
```
# OUTBOUND allowlist for Redwood POC (replace <RED_EIP_X> and CIDR)
allow tcp from 10.30.0.0/16 to <RED_EIP_1> 443
allow tcp from 10.30.0.0/16 to <RED_EIP_2> 443  # additional EIP if provided
allow udp from 10.30.0.0/16 to <RED_EIP_1> 123   # NTP if required
# If using PrivateLink, ensure customer's subnet routes to the interface ENI(s) are allowed
```

maya_sales_eng: 2-line cost note for finance: "PrivateLink typically incurs a small hourly endpoint fee plus per-GB processing (~$0.02-0.05/hr + $0.01-0.05/GB). VPC peering has no endpoint-hour fee but may incur cross-AZ/regional transfer charges; for ~100GB over 2 weeks expect O($10-100) depending on topology."

ops-bot: Runbook updated: privatelink-and-peering-playbook v3 -> https://redwood.example.com/internal/runbooks/connectivity-playbook :white_check_mark:

laura_sales: Perfect — I'll send this with the snippet and ask for their NetOps contact and the SOC questionnaire entries. Will loop back if they want a Dedicated pilot. Thanks all :pray:
